subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 qualification - Acme Health
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Carlos Ortega <carlos.ortega@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 qualification - Acme Health

Hi Jill and Carlos —

Great to speak with you both today. Quick recap + proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- What we heard: Acme will be processing PHI for a clinical notes ingestion workflow (EDR integration), and security needs include a signed BAA, SOC2 Type II evidence, and a network review for private connectivity.
- Primary requirement: PHI in production — preference toward isolation (dedicated capacity or private VPC) but open to hosted API for non-PHI workloads.
- SLA/throughput: initial pilot 5k requests/day, production ramp to ~100k/day within 6–9 months; latency SLOs in the 200–400ms/token range.

Proposed next steps: 
1) I attached a BAA draft for review (BAA-draft-Acme.docx) — please queue legal review and mark any redlines.
2) I will share our SOC2 Type II summary and a network diagram showing Private VPC and Dedicated options. (See links/attachments.)
3) Security/Infra Qs: could you confirm the list of security contacts and whether you require on-prem deployment or VPC peering only?
4) Let's schedule a 30-minute follow-up with your security/infra team for next Wed or Thu — I can bring our solutions engineer to run through Dedicated vs Private VPC checklist.

If it helps, recommended starting pilot: dedicated capacity for a PHI-enabled sandbox (short-term) while non-PHI production can go to Hosted API. Happy to draft an initial mutual action plan after we sync with security.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[d] 415-555-0132 | dylan.brooks@redwood.com
[Attachment: BAA-draft-Acme.docx]

From: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acmehealth.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>, Carlos Ortega <carlos.ortega@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Ben Walker <ben.walker@acmehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 qualification - Acme Health

Thanks, Dylan — appreciate the notes and proposal. A few quick items from security: 

- We need SOC2 Type II evidence and a summary of the controls that map to our HITRUST/Security requirements. Can you provide the latest SOC2 report and an inventory of third-party subprocessors?
- For connectivity: we prefer VPC peering or Private VPC approach (no sustained PHI over public endpoints). On-prem is a longer lead time; open to it for later phases but initial requirement is strict VPC isolation.
- Compliance: our audit team will request encryption-at-rest details, key management (KMS/HSM options), and data retention/erasure workflows.

Looping in Ben (security lead) — Ben, please confirm availability for a technical review next Wed/Thu afternoon PST.

Also: can Redwood sign our standard BAA? We will mark redlines and return.

Best,
Jill Thompson
Director of Product Operations | Acme Health
jill.thompson@acmehealth.com

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.com>
To: Jill Thompson <jill.thompson@acmehealth.com>, Carlos Ortega <carlos.ortega@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: Deployment mode & HIPAA/SOC2 qualification - Acme Health

Hi Jill / Ben / Carlos —

Thanks — answered inline below and attached the items you requested. 

- SOC2 evidence: attached SOC2-TypeII-report-2026.pdf (summary + attest letter). We also have a controls mapping doc; I'll share the full mapping once we have an NDA/LOU in place if needed.
- Subprocessors: included in the SOC2 appendix, but short list: AWS (us-west-2), Redis Labs (managed caching), and our telemetry vendor (scrubbed for PHI).
- Key management: Redwood supports customer-managed KMS via AWS KMS or HSM integrations for Private deployments; hosted customers can use Redwood-managed KMS with dedicated key options for enterprise tiers.
- Data retention/erasure: we support configurable retention policies and can provide audit logs showing deletion and access events.

Deployment recommendation based on your constraints: 
1) Pilot recommendation: Dedicated capacity (isolated GPU pool) in a VPC with peering to Acme — allows PHI processing without full on-prem and gives predictable throughput and easier onboarding.
2) Private VPC/On-prem: recommended for customers requiring full control of networking and key material — longer lead time (procurement + infra), but supported.
3) Hosted API: acceptable only for non-PHI workloads or pre-processed/metadata-only use cases.

Attachments included: SOC2-TypeII-report-2026.pdf, network-diagram-acme.png, BAA-draft-Acme.docx (with our comments).

Would Wed 26 May 2027 at 1:00pm PT work for a 30-min technical review with Ben + your infra? If yes I will send calendar invite and include our Solutions Engineer (Rishi).

Thanks,
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-TypeII-report-2026.pdf]
